verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a compliance and registered-agent service platform, and a service like that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main Wolters Kluwer host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy CT host redirects into it, so no product content could be read. Nothing documents an official CLI, so the verdict is none rather than na.
